[b]The Arrival[/b]
Word would spread quickly to the Shah that the Wuloosyans had sent their new foreign minister Eikelboom, appointed following her predecessor stepping aside due to the war in Rosenmarkke. 
The shah, not really in the mood to meet with the Wuloosyans at the moment, requested that someone with Great vigor go meet the delegation on the tarmac. The Yzak State Department would approve Cahit Alparslan to meet with the delegation as the representative for the Yzakastanian Shah, along with the foreign minister Izık Öldur. 
The Wuloosyan jet would be permitted to land at the Vyzmír International Presidential Airport, its sleek sides shining in the warm and humid early spring sunlight. Cahit would be seated in his wheelchair, a gold-topped cane clutched in his hand, resting lazily against his leg, a fez perched precariously atop his head. Beside him stood the fifty-year-old Izık Öldur, adjusting his tie as aides walked themselves into place.

[b]March 18, 2028: The Wall[/b]

The Council of 99 has ordered the complete mobilisation of the Estate of Knygta and Deyn, home to 10.3 million citizens or about ⅓ of the Rosenmarkket population and the economic center of Rosenmarkke, the Council of 99 has called for a Wall of security to be built along the Islands.

Across the country volunteer units would begin to form as the Council of 99 removed the restrictions on militias operating in Rosenmarkke, calling for unified citizen command networks to be made by the SCSID to ensure no gap between the citizens and the armed forces in their defense.

In the meantime, the SCSID, having appointed a new commander Ivar Ivierthijng, would begin laying the groundwork for a deeply entrenched guerilla offensive, laying out traps and landmines along the beaches of the islands, the locations of the traps and landmines being recorded on paper, as well as re-activating the network of 1980s and 1990s bunkers along the shorelines. 

In the meantime 340 155 mm self propelled guns with 8x8 truck chassis, 112 152.4 mm self propelled howitzers,  and 654 152 mm towed howitzers would be moved into place along the shorelines and potential landing areas, with the locals of the islands using brush and other natural features to hide the equipment, taking advantage also of the frequent spring storms that had begun to roll through the White Strait in order to move quickly.

Nearly 14,000 conscripts by this point from the Islands had already signed up to join the fight online, with 3 militias of 4,666 individuals being formed along four of the six islands, with another 13,000 regular troops being called up, making the total forces of the Islands 27,000. 

With various ships of the navy sunk, it would be determined that a wider dispersal move would be needed, with the decision being made to push out the older reserve ships into the strait, equipped with small modern systems and anti-air and anti-ship missiles while beginning the process of disguising and moving the main navy ships away from main targets (i.e known bases, ports, and other such places). 

400 AMFVs, 300 IFVs, and 800 ACVs would also be moved to the islands and to crucial chokepoints on the Islands.

In the meantime the city of Vysjllá, the largest and economic heart of Rosenmarkke would undergo its largest wartime preparation ever, with nearly 3.4 million citizens expected to potentially be in danger, the city ordered all non-essential radio and other noise to be shut down, mandatory curfews laid out, and military installations would have their civilian staff evacuated to the mainland. Several SAM and anti-air defenses would be hidden around the city.

A small submarine contingency would be placed near the entrance to the harbor on daily patrol routes.

The Council of 99 in order to curtail rising costs and inflation would order the central bank to begin the issuance of 10-year. 20-year, 50-year, Freedom bonds set at 4.3% interest per annum. Furthermore nationwide interest rates would be cut to 2.3% to curtail investor panic. 

Furthering this, strict temporary price control mechanisms would be ordered to prevent corporate price gouging.
